name: Mount Hyjal
summary: On Mount Hyjal, Nordrassil still crowns the sacred mountain above the second Well of Eternity. In the last battle of the Third War, night elves, humans and orcs held the slopes against the Burning Legion until Archimonde fell at the World Tree's roots. The battle scarred the mountain, and the wounded tree still stands over the Well.

sections.title: The Sacred Mountain
sections.body: Ten thousand years ago, after the Great Sundering, Illidan Stormrage poured stolen waters from the first Well of Eternity into a lake atop Mount Hyjal. There he made a second Well. The Dragon Aspects raised the World Tree Nordrassil over its waters to guard it. Their blessings gave the night elves immortality and bound them deeply to the Emerald Dream. For millennia, the kaldorei watched over the mountain while their druids slept in the barrow deeps beneath it.

sections.title: The Battle of Mount Hyjal
sections.body:
During the Third War, Archimonde led the Scourge and the Burning Legion up Mount Hyjal to drain the Well and destroy the World Tree. Jaina Proudmoore's humans and Thrall's Horde set aside old hatreds to stand with Tyrande Whisperwind and Malfurion Stormrage.

They held the slopes while Malfurion prepared a trap. When Archimonde reached Nordrassil, Malfurion sounded the Horn of Cenarius. Thousands of wisps swarmed the demon, and the tree's stored power tore him apart. The night elves lost their immortality, and Nordrassil was scorched.

sections.title: The Barrow Deeps and the Summit
sections.body: Beneath Mount Hyjal lie the barrow deeps, where the Druids of the Claw slept in bear form for thousands of years. Malfurion woke them with the Horn of Cenarius to fight the Legion. Today, the barrow deeps and hyjal summit, high on the mountain, rank among Kalimdor's most perilous places. Only great war bands of seasoned heroes can face them.

aliases: how to get to mount hyjal
faq.answer: Mount Hyjal rises in northern Kalimdor, bordered by Ashenvale, felwood and winterspring. Its summit holds the World Tree Nordrassil and the second Well of Eternity.

faq.q: What happened at the Battle of Mount Hyjal?
faq.answer: At the end of the Third War, Archimonde led the Burning Legion and the Scourge up Mount Hyjal to destroy the World Tree. Humans, orcs and night elves held the slopes together until Malfurion Stormrage sounded the Horn of Cenarius at Nordrassil. Then thousands of wisps and the tree's own power destroyed the demon lord.

faq.q: Why did the night elves lose their immortality here?
faq.answer: Nordrassil's blessings kept the night elves ageless. When the tree's power destroyed Archimonde, those blessings burned away, and the kaldorei became mortal.

The barrow deeps are an ancient cave system beneath Mount Hyjal, where the Druids of the Claw slept in the Emerald Dream for thousands of years. Malfurion Stormrage woke them to fight the Burning Legion. Their depths are now among Kalimdor's most dangerous places.
Hyjal Summit is the high ground of Mount Hyjal, among Kalimdor's most perilous places. Only the strongest war bands venture there.

angles.text: As a night elf, you know Hyjal as your people's holiest ground. Here, the kaldorei gave up their immortality so the World Tree could destroy Archimonde.
Thrall's Horde fought on these slopes beside humans and night elves to stop the Burning Legion.
Jaina Proudmoore's survivors of Lordaeron held the first line on Hyjal's slopes. They bought the night elves the time they needed.
As a druid, you hold Hyjal sacred. Your order slept for ages in the barrow deeps beneath it, and its World Tree once bound you to the Emerald Dream.
